query.interpretation: Activity-period filter and total-award-amount sort; not FY2025 obligations or awards started during FY2025. Bounded top-award sample, not representative.

interpretation: Unlabeled statistical review queue only. No ground-truth fraud/waste labels or adjudication; no precision/recall, causal, value-for-money, or misconduct claim.
limitations: API sample is sorted by total award amount and capped at the top 1,000 records, causing selection bias.
The API activity-period filter is not a filter on award start date or FY2025 obligations.
The 1% contamination setting controls the approximate review queue size and is not an estimated event prevalence.
The model and agency frequencies are fit on the same bounded sample.
